name: @salutejs/sdds-mcp

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: This tool retrieves the names of all available plasma-web components.

tools.name: get_installation_guide
tools.description: This tool retrieves the plasma-web installation and setup guide. It describes how to hook a theme and tokens.

tools.name: get_nextjs_guide
tools.description: This tool retrieves the plasma-web guide for connecting the library in a Next.js project.

tools.name: get_functions
tools.description: This tool retrieves the combined description of imported plasma-web hocs, hooks, mixins, and utils from the functions section.

tools.name: get_design_system_configuration
tools.description: This tool retrieves the combined plasma-web design system configuration, including typography, colors, and spacing documentation.

tools.name: get_form_guide
tools.description: This tool retrieves the combined plasma-web form guides for native HTML forms, React Hook Form, and component support in these forms.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: This tool retrieves the list of plasma-web tokens that can be reused in custom components.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: This tool provides complete information about any plasma-web component, including properties, design props (size, variant, etc.), attributes, configuration options, and practical implementation examples from basic usage to advanced scenarios with complete code snippets.

tools.name: get_component_props
tools.description: This tool provides comprehensive details about a specific plasma-web component, including its properties, design-related props (such as size and variant), attributes, and available configuration options.

tools.name: get_component_examples
tools.description: This tool retrieves example code and usage patterns with complete code snippets. Access practical implementation examples for any plasma-web component, from basic usage to advanced configurations and common use cases.
